items.text: Single-window mode: closing a workspace can be undone, and the undo brings it back on show.
The pane sidebar relaunch test now opens the way the user's app does, and proves every window comes back folded.
A test now replays an update's relaunch of several windows and proves folded panes come back folded.
Single-window mode: a window mode chosen in Settings takes effect once every window is closed.
